header: Questions that open one at a time
lead: Two to thirty rows, all closed when the page loads. The browser does the work: this element uses no script.

questions.title: How does it work without a script?
questions.bodytext: Each row is a details element, and all rows share one name attribute. The browser then closes the open row when you open another one.

questions.title: Does find-in-page still work?
questions.bodytext: Yes. Browsers open a closed row to show a match. Accordions built with scripts often break this.

questions.title: Do the questions appear in the page outline?
questions.bodytext: Yes. Each question is a level-three heading, so screen reader users can jump between questions without opening them.

questions.title: Can two accordions be on one page?
questions.bodytext: Yes. Each accordion forms its own group, so opening a row in one does not close rows in the other.
